title: Accenture Song - Customer Strategy Manager
teaser: As a Customer Strategy Manager, you will apply your expertise in sales & commerce to define and enable growth strategies and approaches to help...
jd:
About Accenture Song:
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. With strong client relationships and deep industry expertise, we help our clients operate at the speed of life through the unlimited potential of imagination, technology, and intelligence.
Job Description:
We are seeking an experienced professional with deep growth strategy and front office transformation experience with focus within one or more of insurance, banking, wealth management, retail, consumer goods, hospitality, travel industry.
Key areas you focus on may include sales (advisor) effectiveness / enablement, go-to-market strategies, B2B / B2C direct to customer growth, channel strategy, lead management, and sales operating model design. Additional experience across marketing and service strategy and other industries is a plus.
You are a problem solver with strong project delivery within industry or consulting experience who is comfortable working in fast-paced, agile environments. You have experience managing executive-level client relationships as a trusted advisor, facilitating workshops, developing business recommendations, and building business cases for new innovative solutions (e.g. AI / Gen-AI enabled capabilities). You know how to balance project delivery responsibilities of your team as well as managing project progress up to account leadership.
You also are:
• Passionate about helping clients solve complex growth and customer experience challenges, as well as supporting them through strategictransformations.
• Knowledgeable about the nuances of the one or more of the insurance, banking, wealth management, retail, consumer goods, travel industry broadly as well as front-line sales and commerce organizations and are ready to apply your knowledge to help clients optimize and transform their sales and service solutions.
• Experienced with managing executive level client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor, while managing junior team members to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Ready to dive deep into problem solving using creative and analytical thinking to transform challenges into opportunities.
• Energized by working in an agile, fast-paced environment and are at your best when collaborating with a team.
• Familiar with the selling processes and have pitched proposals and solutions to help solve client challenges.
As a Customer Strategy Manager, you will apply your expertise in sales & commerce to define and enable growth strategies and approaches to help clients achieve top line growth objectives with a focus on sales and channel / distribution. You will deliver on engagements in the following areas:
Thought Leadership
Able to understand client needs, support the development of proposed solutions, and deliver high-impact projects by partnering with clients to help them support and transform their sales organizations and advance their position in the Financial Services market.
Build client relationships to sustain Accenture’s profile as a long-term trusted advisor and partner.
Manage and coach junior team members while continuing to grow your own expertise to help Accenture maintain its thought leadership position.
Delivery Execution
Design and execute large scale and complex transformation programs and strategy engagements including current state assessments, target state design, and operating model transformations.
Implement business changes that drive industry-specific, functional, and digital operating model transformation.
Synthesize overall technology needs by analyzing a wide variety of solutions, selecting the most relevant tools & techniques to meet specific client requirements.
Manage implementation engagements (requirements, design, test, deployment, etc.), from client buy-in to planning, budgeting, deliverables, and risk assessment, with heavy client engagement and large delivery teams.
Sales & Origination
Originate, qualify, and close new opportunities for Accenture with our clients, including sales (advisor) enablement, go-to-market strategies, direct to customer growth, lead management, and sales operating model design.
Drive pipeline opportunities from initial idea to contract to implementation, leveraging the best capabilities and offerings across Accenture (Song, Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations).
Manage performance and profitability of sold deals, and identify opportunities for extension, cross-sell, or up-sell.
Experience, Attributes and Qualifications:
5+ years of industry experience in one or more of insurance, banking, wealth management, retail, consumer goods and travel industry, leading transformations specifically in a sales, operations, product, or strategy role. A robust understanding of the industry, along with familiarity with topic areas such as sales enablement, go-to-market strategies, direct to customer growth, lead management, and sales operating model design, is required.
2+ years of experience in strategy consulting, with broad experience in engagement management, business development, and leading complex programs / transformations.
3+ year of experience with supporting the development strategic recommendations (or decisions) for critical experiences, products, or services of the organization (and/or)
Managing a P&L or a pipeline of business development opportunities (and/or)
Providing enterprise level business or technology advisory all the way to various executives (VP / SVP or c-suite level)
Preferred Qualifications:
You have excellent communication (written and spoken) and interpersonal skills, including compelling story telling skills for an executive audience and the ability to interact with diverse stakeholders.
You have strong client relationship development and client management skills.
You’ve implemented Commerce platforms, Experience platforms, CRM, CDP, Loyalty programs, MarTech solutions, and/or Sales Transformation initiatives.

title: 香港及海外升學銷售顧問
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser:
- 底薪 ＋ 高額業績提成 ＋ 豐厚成單獎金，成單快、客單價高，付出與回報完全成正比
- 直接對接注重子女教育的高端家庭，快速累積教育圈與商務高端人脈
- 資深名校顧問與精英導師一對一培訓，全面掌握升學體系與成單技巧，小白也能快速上手
- 扁平化管理、資源共享、互相支持，專注業績與自我成長
jd:
>
工作內容
1. 客戶開發與銷售成單
主動發掘有「本地名校插班、海外留學、國際學校、升學背景提升」等需求的家長與學生，提供量身定制的升學方案並促成簽約。
2. 升學路徑與教育諮詢
深入了解學生的學術背景與家庭期望，提供專業的幼小中升學、DSE/IB/A-Level 課程規劃及海外名校留學建議。
3. 綜合身分與教育聯動規劃
協同團隊為跨境及新來港家庭提供一站式「身分＋升學」解決方案，解答學位申請、簽證及適應等痛點。
4. 申請跟進與客情維護
協助跟進學生的申請材料準備、面試培訓進度及學校溝通；做好家長長期關係維護，積極促進老客戶口碑與轉介紹。
任職要求
學歷與簽證：大專/大學或以上學歷；非常歡迎應屆畢業生、海外留學生、持 IANG / 高才通 / 優才簽證人士。
語言與溝通：普通話及廣東話流利，熱情開朗、親和力強，善於與家長及學生溝通，具備同理心與耐性。
銷售熱情：具備強烈的賺錢慾望與目標感，敢於挑戰高薪，具備良好的抗壓能力與成單意識。
加分項：有留學中介、國際學校/補習培訓、教育諮詢、保險理財或高端銷售經驗者優先考慮（無相關經驗但學習能力強、熱愛教育行業同樣歡迎！）。
